newsitem.title: USA: Chevron Calif. FCC unit shut for maintenance.
newsitem.headline: Chevron Calif. FCC unit shut for maintenance.

text.p: Chevron Corp confirmed on Friday it began maintenance yesterday on a 60,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) fluid catalytic cracker (FCC) at its El Segundo, Calif., refinery.
"We shut down late yesterday afternoon," a refinery spokesman said. "We'll be down several weeks."
The FCC is part of the 230,000 bpd refinery and helps process crude oil into gasoline.
West Coast traders and brokers said maintenance on such units generally takes four weeks.
